resources.string: Sync calendars directly with your Nextcloud server. The app only talks to the server you enter, always over HTTPS.
Enter the address of your Nextcloud server. You will sign in in your browser; the app never sees your main password, only a revocable app password that it keeps encrypted.
Waiting for you to sign in in the browser. Come back here when you are done.
That does not look like a server address. Use something like cloud.example.com.
Plain http:// is not allowed. Use an https:// address: your password would otherwise travel unprotected.
This address does not answer like a Nextcloud server. Check it and try again.
Could not reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
The server\'s security certificate is not trusted, so the connection was refused. Fix the certificate on the server, or install its authority on this phone.
The sign-in took too long and expired. Try again.
Could not reach the server. It will try again when there is a connection.
The server no longer accepts this sign-in. Sign out and connect again.
The last sync failed. Try again in a moment.

resources.string: Turn a calendar off to stop syncing it and hide it here. Nothing changes on the server.
No calendars yet. They appear after the first sync.
The app password is revoked on the server, and this account\'s calendars and events are removed from this phone. Changes that were not synced yet are lost. Your data on the server is not touched.
Adds the app password of your CalDAV account to the encrypted file, so restoring it signs you in again. Whoever has the file and the passphrase could use it: keep both safe.
Signed in to your CalDAV server again.
The server no longer accepts the saved sign-in. Settings were restored; connect to the server again.
Could not reach the server to check the saved sign-in. Settings were restored; connect again from Settings › Accounts.
The saved CalDAV address is not valid, so it was not used. Settings were restored.
This phone is already signed in to a CalDAV account, so the one in the backup was not used.
